# TIL113 - Photo-Darlington optocoupler (GaAs infrared LED + NPN Darlington)

Package DIP-6 · family opto · catalogue file [catalog/chips/TIL113.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/TIL113.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 55 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![TIL113 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/TIL113.png) | ![TIL113 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-TIL113.png) | ![TIL113 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-TIL113.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Details |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ANODE | analog | infrared LED anode |
| 2 | CATHODE | analog | infrared LED cathode |
| 3 | NC | nc |  |
| 4 | EMITTER | analog | Darlington phototransistor emitter |
| 5 | COLLECTOR | analog | Darlington phototransistor collector |
| 6 | BASE | analog | phototransistor base |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 5 | Current through the LED turns the Darlington phototransistor on: collector current at least 30 mA at IF 10 mA, VCE 1 V (300% minimum transfer ratio). LED forward voltage 1.5 V max at 10 mA. VCE(sat) 1 V max at IC 125 mA, IF 50 mA. Dark current 100 nA max at VCE 10 V. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputMaxVoltageV | 30 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Limits: input-output 1.5 kV; VCEO 30 V, VCBO 30 V, VEBO 7 V, VECO 7 V; LED IF 100 mA, VR 3 V. outputMaxVoltageV = VCEO. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 15 V, IC(on) 125 mA, RL 100 ohm, TA 25 C.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| IF | COLLECTOR | rise | 300000 |
| IF | COLLECTOR | fall | 300000 |

## Not known

- Rise/fall time printed once per row (300 us); read as typical.
- The electrical table text layer mixes the TIL113 and TIL119 columns; the 30 mA on-state minimum is supported by the "300% minimum at 10 mA" feature line.

## Notes

Times in ns: 300 us = 300000 ns.
